056        public static List<CampaignInputListener> getSortedInputListeners() {
057                List<CampaignInputListener> list = Global.getSector().getListenerManager().getListeners(CampaignInputListener.class);
058                Collections.sort(list, new Comparator<CampaignInputListener>() {
059                        public int compare(CampaignInputListener o1, CampaignInputListener o2) {
060                                return o2.getListenerInputPriority() - o1.getListenerInputPriority();
061                        }
062                });
063                return list;
064        }
065        public static void processCampaignInputPreCore(List<InputEventAPI> events) {
066                for (CampaignInputListener x : getSortedInputListeners()) {
067                        x.processCampaignInputPreCore(events);
068                }
069        }

313        public static int countOtherFactors(SectorEntityToken entity) {
314                int count = 0;
315                for (ColonyOtherFactorsListener x : Global.getSector().getListenerManager().getListeners(ColonyOtherFactorsListener.class)) {
316                        if (x.isActiveFactorFor(entity)) count++;
317                }
318                return count;
319        }
320        public static boolean hasOtherFactors(SectorEntityToken entity) {
321                return countOtherFactors(entity) > 0;
322        }

324        public static List<EncounterPoint> generateEncounterPoints(LocationAPI where) {
325                List<EncounterPoint> result = new ArrayList<EncounterPoint>();
326                if (where == null) return result;
327                for (EncounterPointProvider x : Global.getSector().getListenerManager().getListeners(EncounterPointProvider.class)) {
328                        List<EncounterPoint> curr = x.generateEncounterPoints(where);
329                        if (curr != null) {
330                                result.addAll(curr);
331                        }
332                }
333                return result;
334        }
